descricao: Brilliant Evermore is a vast, barren, and polluted landscape marked with extreme weather, burning sunlight, and harmful smog. The structures that are few and far between can be used as a shield against the elements and contain large quantities of valuable objects, but it is not advised to enter this level as it is near impossible to find an exit. The sky can be clear or overcast. Rain is uncommon, but when it does occur, it will happen in large storms that have high winds and heavy lightning. This is usually accompanied by flash flooding.
